en: Black-and-white aerial photograph of a small lakeside village with scattered houses, gardens, fields, and a prominent white church with a tall spire. A forested area borders the lake in the background, and a road runs along the shoreline with additional houses. The style is typical of an early-to-mid-20th-century rural Scandinavian postcard. In the lower-left corner there is printed text indicating the place and type of photograph.
